name: EEG-Based Machine Learning Challenges
description: Develop models to predict response times and psychopathology scores using EEG data, emphasizing transfer learning and regression tasks.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: Participants receive EEG data (128-channel recordings), demographic data (age, gender, handedness, psychological factors), and event labels for cognitive tasks. Example: EEG epochs are 2-second segments recorded post-stimulus onset.
cr:input.url: [FILL IN THE BLANK: URL to the competition dataset]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predicted response times for the CCD task (0.5–2.5 seconds) and continuous psychopathology scores for internalization, externalization, attention, and p-factor.

field.name: id
field.description: unique identifier for each sample, e.g., eeg_sample_001

field.name: pred_response_time
field.description: predicted response time for the CCD task, ranging from 0.5 to 2.5 seconds

cr:evaluation.notes: nRMSE is computed as RMSE divided by the standard deviation of the true values. Overall ranking combines scores from both challenges using weighted averaging: 0.3 * S1 + 0.7 * S2.
